title: Add unit tests for `ItemList`

milestone.title: 4.x
milestone.description: Issues and pull requests slated for an undetermined Godot 4 release.

body:
Contributes to #43440

Adds unit tests for `ItemList` covering:

* Defaults: empty list, selection state, modes/columns/layout/behavior flags, plus constructor overrides (`FOCUS_ALL`, clip-contents, scrollbars)
* Item CRUD with negative indices, `set_item_count` grow and shrink, `add_item` with `selectable=false`, `add_icon_item` round-trip
* `clear()` resetting count, current, and selection, including the empty-list idempotent path
* `remove_item` current-row semantics: clearing current in single mode, preserving current and selection when a later row is removed, and surviving selections when the current row is removed in multi mode
* Selection in `SELECT_SINGLE`: replace, deselect resetting current to `-1`, no-op on disabled and non-selectable items, `deselect_all`
* Selection in `SELECT_MULTI`: additive `select(idx, false)` vs. exclusive `select(idx)`, non-selecting `set_current`, single-row `deselect`, `deselect_all`
* `move_item` updating current for the first selected row in single and multi modes
* `sort_items_by_text` re-syncing current in single mode and leaving current untouched in multi mode (selection flags travel with items)
* `find_metadata` round-trips for int, `String`, and `Vector2`, and not-found returning `-1`
* Guards: `set_max_text_lines(0)`, `set_fixed_column_width(-1)`, out-of-range `TextDirection`, NaN `icon_scale`, out-of-range `remove_item`

Fork CI: workflow tests completed successfully on [`calbebop/godot`](https://github.com/calbebop/godot) for branch `test-item-list`.

AI disclosure: I designed the test plan, wrote and reviewed the changes, and validated style and behavior against `ItemList` in-tree. Cursor helped with research and drafting.
